description: Summary before the team's planning: sprint status + knowledge-base context + recent notes.
prompt: Write a concise summary for the team before planning. 1) Check the current sprint status in Jira (open tickets, readiness, health). 2) Pull relevant context from the knowledge base (KB). 3) Look through the latest meeting notes. Return a post ready to paste into the chat, with sections 'Sprint status', 'Open topics', 'What to watch for in planning'. No preamble.

name: Planning — TeamA
description: Sprint planning prep for TeamA — welcome, absences, backlog review per person, GIF.

name: Daily — TeamA
description: TeamA daily standup — who did not log time, what the team did on the previous working day.

name: Daily worklog — TeamA
description: What TeamA logged in Tempo for the previous working day (Jira direct, per person), missing logs with an @tag, leave from the calendar.

name: Daily worklog — TeamB
description: What TeamB logged in Tempo for the previous working day.

name: Missing time log — 12:00 recap
description: 12:00 recap for managers (no @tags): who across all teams did not log time for the previous working day and who was on leave. No AI.

name: Morning Pulse
description: Morning report from Snowflake: how team leads acted on yesterday's staffing suggestions.
prompt: Call report_morning_pulse with no parameters. Write one sentence with the most important number from the result and give the link to the report. If the result starts with DEMO:, say it is sample data. If it starts with ERROR:, say briefly that there is no report today.
